must_have_properties: Every command shall be decoded from the simultaneous state of CKE / CS# / RAS# / CAS# / WE# at the rising edge of CK (per Command Truth Table).
RESET# shall be HIGH during normal operation and asserted LOW (≤ 0.2 × VDD) only during power-up (≥ 200 µs) or reset-with-stable-power (≥ 100 ns).
Initialization shall follow the 12-step sequence: power ramp → RESET# LOW ≥ 200 µs → RESET# HIGH + 500 µs → CKE rise + tXPR → MRS(MR2, MR3, MR1, MR0 with DLL Reset) → ZQCL → tDLLK + tZQinit.
Mode registers MR0..MR3 shall be re-programmed after every power-up; their contents are volatile.
All MRS / REF / SRE / ZQCL / ZQCS commands shall be issued only when all banks are precharged and tRP is satisfied.
tMRD (4 nCK) and tMOD (max(12 nCK, 15 ns)) shall be honoured between successive MRS commands and from MRS to a non-MRS command.
Refresh average interval shall be ≤ tREFI; up to 8 REF may be postponed or pulled in; the rolling maximum interval between two surrounding REFs shall not exceed 9 × tREFI.
tRFC(min) shall be honoured between a REF and the next valid command except NOP/DES.
Self-Refresh entry shall be only from All-Banks-Idle with ODT held LOW (or RTT_Nom disabled in MR1).
After Self-Refresh exit, one extra REF shall be issued before re-entering Self-Refresh.
tFAW shall be honoured: no more than 4 ACTIVATE commands within any rolling tFAW window.
tRRD shall be honoured between successive ACTIVATEs to different banks.
Read bursts shall return DQ at RL = AL + CL cycles after the RD/RDA command; DQS shall be edge-aligned with DQ during reads.
Write bursts shall accept DQ at WL = AL + CWL cycles after the WR/WRA command; DQS shall be centred in DQ during writes.
tCCD shall be ≥ 4 nCK between successive column commands.
tWR (write recovery) shall be ≥ programmed WR value in MR0 from last data beat to PRE on the same bank.
tWTR shall be ≥ max(4 nCK, 7.5 ns) from last write data beat to subsequent RD.
ZQCL shall be issued at end of initialization; ZQCS shall be issued periodically based on V/T drift rates.
On-Die Termination shall obey ODTLon = ODTLoff = CWL + AL − 2 cycles in synchronous ODT mode.
VREFCA shall track VDD/2 nominal; VREFDQ shall track VDDQ/2 nominal. Both shall remain stable in Self-Refresh.
Differential CK and DQS shall meet AC swing ≥ 0.350 V (peak-to-peak) with the crossing point Vix within ±150 mV of VDD/2.
must_not_have_properties: Burst reads or writes shall not be terminated or interrupted by another command; fixed-vs-OTF BL is set by MR0.
Self-Refresh shall not be entered during an in-progress READ or WRITE burst, ACTIVATE, PRECHARGE, REFRESH, or MRS.
CKE shall not transition LOW during Mode Register Set, MPR operation, ZQCAL operation, DLL locking, or any read/write operation.
ODT shall not be asserted during DLL-off mode (RTT_Nom must be disabled in MR1).
ODT shall not be active during Self-Refresh.
MRS shall not be issued when any bank is in the Active state.
CK frequency shall not change outside of Self-Refresh or Precharge Power-Down.
ZQ shall not be calibrated while the DQ bus on the affected DRAMs is active.
Two DRAMs sharing a single ZQ resistor shall not have overlapping calibration windows.
DDR3 shall not be plugged into a DDR2 socket; notch positions differ to prevent insertion (VDD mismatch).
Without RESET# asserted at power-up, DDR3 behaviour is undefined.

compliance_failure_modes.mode: Missed refresh (more than 9 × tREFI between REFs)
compliance_failure_modes.trigger: Refresh scheduler bug or extended Power-Down without REF — cell data may be lost; DRAM does not flag the error.
Slew rate too slow, jitter too high, or trace delay exceeds budget — DRAM may register garbage commands or write data corruption.

compliance_failure_modes.mode: MRS in wrong state (banks open or wrong order)
compliance_failure_modes.trigger: Controller issues MRS before PREA / tRP completes — DRAM behaviour undefined.

compliance_failure_modes.mode: Self-Refresh entry with ODT HIGH or RTT enabled
compliance_failure_modes.trigger: Controller forgot to drive ODT LOW pre-SRE — DRAM termination state is undefined during SR.
WR with BC4 followed immediately by another WR before tCCD expires — second WR is rejected/garbled.
Aggressive scheduler exceeds 4-bank activate power limit — DRAM may exceed peak current rating.
Periodic ZQCS missed; Ron / Rtt drift; read/write errors degrade gradually.
DQS-CK skew on fly-by DIMM causes write data to miss the DQS window; data corruption.

compliance_failure_modes.mode: DLL out of lock when used
compliance_failure_modes.trigger: Command requiring DLL issued before tDLLK after DLL Reset / SR exit — read timing is unreliable.
Dynamic frequency scaling without SR/PPD entry — DRAM internal state undefined.

fields.min_clock_constraint: Per speed-grade tCK range: DDR3-800 supports tCK 2.5 ns; DDR3-1066 supports 2.5 ≥ tCK > 1.875; DDR3-1333 supports 1.875 ≥ tCK > 1.5; DDR3-1600 supports 1.5 ≥ tCK > 1.25. DLL-off mode supports up to tCKDLL_OFF (vendor-defined, typically ≤ 8 ns / ≤ 125 MHz).
fields.reset_behavior_compliance: Asserting RESET# LOW asynchronously returns the DRAM to its reset state — all banks closed, MR0..MR3 cleared to undefined defaults (must be re-programmed), ODT in high impedance, output drivers Hi-Z. CKE must be pulled LOW ≥ 10 ns before RESET# rises. After RESET# rises, the 12-step initialization sequence (starting from step 4 of the power-up sequence) must complete before normal operation resumes.
